searches.title: People to look up
searches.description: List of people to find on Google Scholar. Each item needs a `name` and optionally an `affiliation` (university, lab, company) to disambiguate.

profileUrls.title: Profile URLs (skip search)
profileUrls.description: Google Scholar citation profile URLs to scrape directly, e.g. https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=XXXX. These skip the Google search step entirely.

maxPublications.title: Max publications per profile
maxPublications.description: How many publications to load per profile. Scholar loads 20 at a time; the actor clicks 'Show more' until this many are loaded.

keywordTopN.title: Research domain keywords
keywordTopN.description: How many keywords to extract from the latest publication year's titles and venues.

timeoutSeconds.title: Page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for each page to load before giving up.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google blocks datacenter traffic aggressively. RESIDENTIAL proxies are strongly recommended.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Run Chrome headless. Turn off only when running locally to debug CAPTCHAs.

maxRetriesPerTarget.title: Retries per target
maxRetriesPerTarget.description: How many times to retry a person/profile with a fresh browser and proxy session if Google blocks the request.
